units.source_text: 据说，七段六岁的长女对围棋边看边学，久而久之，也无师自通了。

en.t: It is said that the six-year-old eldest daughter of the seventh-dan player learned go by watching as she went along, and before long taught herself without a teacher.

units.source_text: “前些时候，我让她九个子，还留下棋谱呢。”

en.t: Some time ago, I gave her a nine-stone handicap, and I even kept the record of the game.
